# Psalm 44 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 44:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For-the-choirmaster. Of-the-sons of-Korah. A-Maskil.
- **LOGOS:** For the choirmaster. A Maskil of the Sons of Korah.
- **PNEUMA:** For the music director. A psalm of the descendants of Korah.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 44:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** O-God, with-our-ears we-have-heard, our-fathers have-told-us, the-deeds You-did in-their-days, in-days of-old.
- **LOGOS:** O God, we have heard with our ears, our fathers have told us, what deeds You performed in their days, in the days of old:
- **PNEUMA:** O God, we have heard it with our own ears — our ancestors have told us of all You did in their day, in days long ago:

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 44:6 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Through-You we-push-down our-adversaries; through-Your-name we-trample those-rising against-us.
- **LOGOS:** Through You we push down our foes; through Your name we tread down those who rise up against us.
- **PNEUMA:** Only by Your power can we push back our enemies; only in Your name can we trample our foes.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 44:8 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For You-have-saved-us from-our-adversaries, and-those-hating-us You-have-put-to-shame.
- **LOGOS:** But You have saved us from our foes and have put to shame those who hate us.
- **PNEUMA:** You are the One who gives us victory over our enemies; You disgrace those who hate us.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 44:10 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Yet You-have-rejected and-humiliated-us, and-You-do-not go-out with-our-armies.
- **LOGOS:** But You have rejected us and disgraced us and have not gone out with our armies.
- **PNEUMA:** But now You have rejected and humiliated us. You no longer lead our armies to battle.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 44:11 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** You-make-us turn-back from-the-adversary, and-those-hating-us plunder for-themselves.
- **LOGOS:** You have made us turn back from the foe, and those who hate us have plundered us.
- **PNEUMA:** You make us retreat from our enemies and allow those who hate us to plunder our land.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
